description: Offline iPhone and iPad estimates and invoices for small trade contractors, with direct-cost and gross-margin checks.
pricing: First 3 quotes free with full PDFs; created records remain viewable and exportable. Optional monthly or annual ScopeBid Pro subscription unlocks unlimited quoting and the full Business Memory, job costing and invoicing workflow. Local prices and trial eligibility are shown before purchase.
notes: Submitted by James Gray, the developer. Relevant to small trade contractors quoting fit-outs, repairs or other property work: enter labour and materials, compare customer price with direct cost, preview a discount’s effect on estimated gross margin, and produce a PDF quote. ScopeBid also supports change orders, invoices and manual payment records. It is not a property-management system, construction ERP, accounting package or payment processor. No account is required; the listing states quoting, PDFs, invoices and records work offline. English; iPhone and iPad; iOS/iPadOS 18 or later. Please assess independently for your Construction & Development category. Current listing and screenshots: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scopebid-estimate-invoice/id6796729890
